target.title: fix(codex): keep tool echo prefixes UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Codex native tool-progress echo signatures truncated raw tool output with
`String.prototype.slice`. At the 10_000-char transcript budget, an emoji
surrogate pair can land on the cut and leave a lone UTF-16 code unit in the
stored echo prefix. That corrupts prefix matching and can wrongly suppress (or
fail to suppress) later assistant/tool echoes.

Sibling transcript helpers in the same files already use `truncateUtf16Safe`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use `truncateUtf16Safe` in both echo-prefix writers:

- `toolOutputRawEchoSignature` (aggregate/raw signature) — write site 1
- `rememberEcho` stored `prefix` cap — write site 2

Add production-path proof that exercises both write sites through the real
projector caller (`turn/completed` → `rememberCommandAggregateOutputEcho`),
plus a direct helper test, with verbatim `[utf16-echo-proof]` logs at the
10_000 UTF-16 emoji boundary.

## User Impact

**Before:** Tool-stream echo dedupe prefixes could split surrogate pairs → bad
prefix / incorrect echo suppression for emoji-heavy tool output.

**After:** Echo prefixes stay on whole code points, matching transcript
truncation.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector-tool-output.ts`,
  `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector-tool-progress.ts`,
  `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.progress-echo.test.ts`,
  `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector-tool-output-echo.test.ts`
- Production path: Codex app-server projector →
  `rememberCommandAggregateOutputEcho` → `toolOutputRawEchoSignature` /
  `rememberEcho`
- Rebased onto current `main` after projector test split into
  `event-projector.progress-echo.test.ts`

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

At budget 10_000 with `"a"*9999 + "😀" + …`:

- raw `text.slice(0, 10000)` ends with lone high surrogate `0xD83D`
- `toolOutputRawEchoSignature` returns prefix `"a"*9999` with no surrogates
- projector aggregate echo storage (`rememberEcho`) has no lone surrogates

### Canonical reachability path

`turnCompleted(commandExecution.aggregatedOutput)` →
`rememberCommandAggregateOutputEcho` → `toolOutputRawEchoSignature` →
`rememberEcho` (`prefix: truncateUtf16Safe(...)`)

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Reuses existing `truncateUtf16Safe` from
`openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` (same helper as transcript bounds).

### Real environment tested

Local trusted checkout importing the production helper and projector path
(exact write sites, not only the shared truncate helper).
Node v22.23.1; PR head `094b4801020`.
Sibling `../codex` checkout was not accessible from this environment; live
Codex app-server session was not run.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector-tool-output-echo.test.ts \
  extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.progress-echo.test.ts \
  -t "aggregate echo prefixes UTF-16|does not split a surrogate" \
  --reporter=verbose
```

### Evidence after fix

```text
[utf16-echo-proof] write_sites=toolOutputRawEchoSignature+rememberEcho
[utf16-echo-proof] broken_slice_last_codeunit=d83d
[utf16-echo-proof] stored_prefix_len=9999
[utf16-echo-proof] stored_prefix_last_codeunit=61
[utf16-echo-proof] stored_prefix_has_surrogate=false
[utf16-echo-proof] stored_raw_length=10401
 ✓ keeps aggregate echo prefixes UTF-16 safe at the transcript budget via projector write sites 175ms

[utf16-echo-proof] write_site=toolOutputRawEchoSignature.rawPrefix
[utf16-echo-proof] budget=10000
[utf16-echo-proof] broken_slice_len=10000
[utf16-echo-proof] broken_slice_last_codeunit=d83d
[utf16-echo-proof] safe_prefix_len=9999
[utf16-echo-proof] safe_prefix_last_codeunit=61
[utf16-echo-proof] safe_prefix_has_surrogate=false
 ✓ does not split a surrogate pair at the transcript budget (raw .slice would) 1ms
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  2 passed | 7 skipped (9)
```

### Observed result after fix

Before (raw slice at write sites): last code unit `0xD83D` (lone high surrogate).
After (production writers): stored/safe prefix length `9999`, last code unit
`0x61` (`a`), `stored_prefix_has_surrogate=false`, raw length preserved as
`10401`. Projector path logs both write sites together.

### What was not tested

Live Codex app-server session against a real model with emoji tool output.
Proof is the production projector caller + both echo-prefix write sites used by
app-server, with verbatim runtime proof logs.

### Fix classification

bugfix — Unicode / echo-prefix correctness

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted implementation and proof.
